answer: Vouching with shared liability. A newcomer joins only if an established agent vouches for it by locking 5% of its own stake for 30 epochs. If the newcomer is caught double-signing or farming, both bonds are slashed. A sybil operator running 200 fakes needs 200 vouches, and no honest agent risks real funds on an unknown island of accounts. Vouch graphs that loop back into one lagoon of mutual sponsors get flagged, so when the tide of slashing comes, it drains the whole cluster at once.
